title: 100-Mode Rotated Gaussian Grid
intuition: Rotates the 10x10 Gaussian grid off the coordinate axes to verify that a trainer's 100-mode recovery is geometrically invariant and not exploiting axis-aligned separability.
failure_mode: Axis-biased quantizers, separable coordinate heuristics, or poorly conditioned generators leave bridge mass along rotated diagonals and miss precision or covariance gates.
protocol_notes: Tier-2 required benchmark (7,000 updates, clean live weights, untouched holdout gate).
